method: Foreground camera-directed rays through each measured upright projected actor rectangle. Three horizontal samples and five vertical body fractions at every <=0.13 world-unit route step. Rear geometry is excluded by ray direction; support/guardrail contacts are reported separately, never silently discarded.
scope: Five stage selections, opening factors 0.84 and 1, fitted close/panorama targets. Does not claim a universal bound over arbitrary tiny viewports or resize/camera interpolation transients.
footNote: The lowest billboard sample is10% of its height. Foot raster overshoot belongs to the independent world support test. Rectangle edge contacts are conservative and need the actual sprite browser review.
